title: Worktrees created outside project at <project>/../.worktrees/<project-name>/<name>/
context: Worktrees are complete second checkouts on disk maintained by git. Nesting one inside the project would replicate the codebase in every file walker.
decision: Place worktrees outside the project folder, at a parallel path. Nesting is deliberately refused.
consequences: Files app, search index, and Vite watcher ignore worktrees without being taught. Nothing has to filter them out specially.
